notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing, fire history, access or visit information was found. Status rests on the 2014 extant list and an undated Landforms listing. The Division's ownership of this tower is not stated on any page read; the MPS covers Division towers and lists this one, so the story does not name an agency field. The November 2023 woods fire is on Walnut Mountain but the report does not tie it to the tower; it is used only as local context. Brief field 'registers: NGS None' is not in the facts schema and was not verified. The Tennessee list in the NHLR crawl cache (76 entries) has no Walnut Mountain entry; a live check is worth doing. Brief coordinates and elevation match the Landforms GPX. Searches: 2 (websearch.py). Page reads: about 6, including the MPS PDF. Note: a central_us_lookouts cache file titled Walnut Mountain is a different site in Oklahoma and was not used.
